body:
In my most recent book, The Great Spiritual Migration, I discuss what faith could learn from science. The same theme was recently taken up in a Slate article:

 Test your assumptions against reality. Question simple explanations. Consider alternatives. Re-examine your methods. Study nature.

 Wise counsel!

 More here:

 https://slate.com/technology/2018/05/what-politics-and-religion-could-learn-from-science.html
